journey:he-qi-gospel-paintings.c: Nanjing, China, and later the United States
journey:he-qi-gospel-paintings.m: Painting in various media, on paper and canvas
journey:he-qi-gospel-paintings.s: Contemporary Chinese Christian art (folk art, Cubism and medieval stained glass)
journey:he-qi-gospel-paintings.noimg: © He Qi. View his work through the artist's official website and published collections.

x.summary: He Qi is one of the best-known Chinese Christian artists. His paintings of the life of Christ, such as the Nativity, the calming of the storm and the Resurrection, combine Chinese folk art, paper cutting and traditional painting with the bright, flat colour of Western modernism. Jesus appears with East Asian features, among figures and landscapes that make the Gospel feel at home in Chinese culture.
facts: According to He Qi, he began painting as a teenager during the Cultural Revolution, when he secretly copied a Raphael Madonna that gave him a sense of peace.
In 1992 he became the first person from mainland China to earn a doctorate in religious art after the Cultural Revolution, and he taught at Nanjing Union Theological Seminary.
His work has been widely used in hymnals, Bibles and church calendars around the world.
